recruiterCard.organization: Space Science and Engineering Center, UW-Madison
recruiterCard.summary: Automated command-line and data-pipeline workflows for researchers working with terabyte-scale atmospheric datasets.
impactBullets: Automated command-line and data-pipeline workflows for terabyte-scale atmospheric research datasets.
Supported 15+ researchers who rely on those workflows for their day-to-day analysis.
Improved first-pass pipeline completion to 90–95% and reduced manual run overhead by about 30%.
